_readme: SURVIVOR POOL — hand-edited. fetch.py never touches this file.
HOW TO UPDATE EACH WEEK — just add the team code, nothing else:
1. Find the season below (e.g. "2025" = the 2025-26 season).
2. Append the manager's new pick to the end of their 'picks' array.
The position in the array IS the NFL week (1st entry = Week 1).
3. A pick is just:  { "team": "KC" }
4. That's it. The site pulls the opponent, the final score and the
win/loss straight from ESPN's public NFL scoreboard when the page
loads, so the block fills in as 'KC 27 - 20 LV' on its own and the
manager is struck through automatically if the pick lost.
5. For a manager who skipped a week, put null in that slot: [ {...}, null, {...} ].
6. Once a manager is eliminated, just stop adding picks for them.
OPTIONAL OVERRIDES (only if ESPN has it wrong, or for an offline copy).
Anything you write by hand always beats the live data:
"score":    "17-34"  — picked team's points FIRST
"opponent": "NYG"
"lost":     true      — force eliminated (false forces survived)
"winner": "Tom" marks whoever won the pool — their name turns gold with a
trophy. Leave it "" while the season is still running.
STARTING A NEW SEASON: copy a season block, change the key to the new year,
empty every 'picks' array, and update the 'managers' list if the group changed.
VALID TEAM CODES: ARI ATL BAL BUF CAR CHI CIN CLE DAL DEN DET GB HOU IND JAX KC
LV LAC LAR MIA MIN NE NO NYG NYJ PHI PIT SEA SF TB TEN WAS
(Common aliases also work: ARZ, GNB, KAN, LVR, SFO, TAM, NOR, WSH, JAC, NWE.)
